spells/water-to-acid-3371.name: Water to Acid
spells/water-to-acid-3371.effectSummary: Transforms up to 1 cubic foot of water per caster level into an equal volume of acid. It cannot transform water inside a creature and cannot affect water containing more than a trace of dissolved or suspended substances. Acid bottled as a splash weapon deals 1d6 damage on a direct hit and 1 splash damage; ongoing contact deals 1d6 acid damage each round. Underwater, the created acid dissipates after 1 round per caster level. It dissolves metallic objects for 1d6 damage per round while ignoring hardness; a magic item makes a Fortitude save each round for half damage. The material component is a few drops of vinegar.
